messages:
maria (marketing): Quick sync: final draft for the Redwood Optimize launch post is ready for approval. Can we lock the publish time and confirm lead routing + webinar CTA?

alexa (growth): Recommend Thursday 9:00 PT so sales has Wed to prep outreach. Also we should A/B test hero CTA wording and email subject lines.

rishi (product): Thursday 9:00 PT works for product. Confirmed benchmark numbers: 36% lower per-token cost and 2.3x median latency improvement. Need method footnote and link to the evaluation appendix.

taylor (growthops): Draft HubSpot routing rules: `if campaign=optimize_launch -> list: launch_optimize; if form=webinar_register -> tag: webinar_early; clicks on CTA -> trigger workflow: nurture_launch`. Will add `utm_campaign=optimize_launch` and `utm_experiment=heroA` variants.

kate (legal): Reviewed claims. Please add footnote: "Benchmarks conducted using open-bench-2026; representative workloads only. See methodology: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-2026" Also, confirm all partner logos have usage approval.

sam (design): Need final hero image (1200x630) and two hero CTA variants: "Join the webinar" vs "See the benchmark". I'll upload image v3 by EOD. Alt text required: "dashboard showing latency and cost reduction".

maria (marketing): Hero copy candidate A: "Cut inference cost by 36% with Redwood Optimize" B: "Speed up LLM latency 2.3x 026 benchmark". Which to A/B?

alexa (growth): A/B both headline and CTA. Headline test: headlineA=cost language, headlineB=latency language. CTA test: ctaA=webinar, ctaB=read benchmark. We'll track in `utm_experiment=headlineA` / `headlineB`.

taylor (growthops): For attribution add `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_experiment=headlineA` on variant A links. Also map submit -> `lifecycle=MQL` for webinar registrants.

kate (legal): Also need to avoid absolutes in hero. Maybe change "Cut" to "Reduce". Provide consent lines for quotes: "Quote used with permission".

rishi (product): OK on "Reduce". I'll send the short benchmark paragraph and link to the eval slate to @maria. Landing page form fields: name, work email, company, job role, primary use case.

maria (marketing): Updated hero A: "Reduce inference cost by 36% with Redwood Optimize". Hero B: "Improve LLM latency 2.3x in our benchmark". Draft footnote text added to bottom of post.

sam (design): Uploaded og:image `optimize-hero-v3.png` to assets. Alt text: "chart comparing latency before and after optimization".

publish-bot: Checklist status: assets present: og:image yes, hero quote no, alt text yes, legal doc link yes. Missing: final 50-70 char hero quote and customer testimonial approval file.

maria (marketing): I'll tighten hero quote and chase testimonial sign-off. Wedding question: embargo window? sales wants a 24-hour heads-up before public. Can we schedule publish Thu 9:00 PT but send an embargoed partner note Wed 9:00 PT?

alexa (growth): Yes, send embargoed partner note Wed 9:00 PT. Use subject "Embargoed: Redwood Optimize launch" and include link to internal preview. Add `X-Embargo: 2026-04-07T16:00Z` in the partner note header.

taylor (growthops): I'll set up the internal preview page and ensure HubSpot forms are hidden until publish. Also configure the SDR assignment: `webinar_early -> queue: optimize_sdr`.

kate (legal): Confirmed testimonial permission received via Doc ID 8842. Add line "Used with permission" under quote.

rishi (product): Final landing page copy inserted. Webinar widget set for Apr 14 10:00 PT. Registration goes to `webinar_early` list.

maria (marketing): Final QA checklist for Friday: 1) hero quote finalized 2) testimonial file attached 3) HubSpot routing tested 4) subject A/B configured 5) legal links present. Please react :thumbsup: if green.

alexa (growth): :thumbsup:
taylor (growthops): :thumbsup:
sam (design): :thumbsup:
kate (legal): :thumbsup:
rishi (product): :thumbsup:
maria (marketing): Locking publish Thu 2026-04-08 09:00 PT if no objections. Thanks team!"
